title: Out-of-Area Proration by Miles Driven — Rotation Odometer Readings
content:
For an out-of-area replacement reimbursed under Road Hazard Protection, a recent Crestline rotation of the covered set decides whether the out-of-area coverage percentage is figured on miles driven. The rotation, its date and its odometer are read from the covered set's Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty history; the warranted miles and original tread depth are those of the set's tire line.

**Figures used.**
- *Miles driven*: the odometer of the covered set's most recent Crestline rotation service less the set's install odometer.
- *Percentage figured on miles*: 100 inside the out-of-area full-replacement period while the miles driven are at most the line's warranted miles times the plan's full-replacement wear figure divided by (the line's original tread depth less the plan's coverage tread limit); otherwise the warranted miles less the miles driven, held at 0 or more, times 100, divided by the warranted miles, rounded down to a whole percent.
- *Percentage figured by months*: 100 inside the out-of-area full-replacement period; outside it, the whole calendar months remaining from the reimbursement date to the expiration date, times 100, divided by the plan term, rounded down to a whole percent.

**Out-of-area proration measure.**

| Most recent Crestline rotation of the covered set | Out-of-area coverage percentage |
|---|---|
| dated no more than 120 days before the reimbursement date | the percentage figured on miles |
| older than 120 days but no more than 365 days | the lower of the percentage figured by months and the percentage figured on miles |
| none within 365 days | the percentage figured by months |

**Boundaries.** A rotation 120 days before the reimbursement date is on miles alone; at 121 days the lower of the two applies; at 365 days still the lower of the two; at 366 days, months alone.

**Hypothetical figures.** Line warranted for 60,000 miles, 10/32 new tread, 2/32 coverage limit, 2/32 wear figure: the in-period miles allowance is 60,000 times 2 divided by 8, that is 15,000 miles. Outside the period, with 21,000 miles driven, the percentage on miles is 39,000 times 100 divided by 60,000, that is 65; with 64,000 miles driven the unused miles are held at 0 and the percentage on miles is 0.
